meta.title: Recreate Order: The Recreate Order window closes without creating an order when Cancel is selected
gaps: Whether selecting Cancel created no new order in the backend
The RFQ's complete unchanged state after cancellation beyond returning to Responses
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Whether selecting Cancel created no new order in the backend; The RFQ's complete unchanged state after cancellation beyond returning to Responses

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer summary page.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the stage Settings menu is available.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order window is open.
Cancel the Recreate Order operation without changing displayed values.
Verify that the Recreate Order window closes.
Verify that the buyer remains on the RFQ Responses screen after cancellation.
